new: A 1982 2 drachmes from Greece. One side shows Georgios Karaiskakis, a commander in the Greek War of Independence; the other shows crossed rifles with a branch, ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗ ΔΗΜΟΚΡΑΤΙΑ, ΔΡΑΧΜΕΣ and the date 1982. Struck in nickel-brass.
source: Grok deep review GRK-2-05; Numista N#549 (https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces549.html): 2 Drachmes 1982-1986, portrait of Georgios Karaiskakis (the Manto Mavrogenous portrait is the later 1988-2000 2 drachmes)
